arxiv-2602-15933.title: KPZ-like transport in long-range interacting spin chains proximate to integrability
arxiv-2602-15933.creator: Sajant Anand, Jack Kemp, Julia Wei, Christopher David White, Michael P. Zaletel, Norman Y. Yao
arxiv-2602-15933.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Sajant Anand, Jack Kemp, Julia Wei, Christopher David White, Michael P. Zaletel, Norman Y. Yao. Isotropic integrable spin chains such as the Heisenberg model feature superdiffusive spin transport belonging to an as-yet-unidentified dynamical universality class closely related to that of Kardar, Parisi, and Zhang (KPZ). To determine whether these results extend to more generic one-dimensional models, particularly those realizable in quantum simulators, we investigate spin and energy transport in non-integrable, long-range Heisenberg models using state-of-the-art tensor network methods.

britannica-1911-quarantine.description: Article 'Quarantine' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 22), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The plague was the only disease for which quarantine was practised (not to mention the earlier isolation of lepers, and the attempts to check the invasion of syphilis in northern Europe about 1490) down to the advent of yellow fever in Spain at the beginning of the 19th century, and the arrival of Asiatic cholera in 1831.

pmc-11037550.title: The Risk and The Course of Cancer Among People with Severe Mental Illness
pmc-11037550.creator: Luigi Grassi, Daniel McFarland, Michelle Riba
pmc-11037550.description: The paucity of data regarding patients with Serious Mental Illness (SMI) and cancer is alarming given the fact that people with SMI, especially schizophrenia, bipolar disorders and severe depressive disorders, have in general poorer access to physical health care and higher morbidity and mortality because of physical illnesses.

pmc-12534973.title: Pleiotrophin modulates cell proliferation, prostate smooth muscle contraction and fibrosis in hyperplastic prostate
pmc-12534973.creator: Jiang Liu, Jiuming Fan, Huan Liu, Mingzhe Chen, Xun Fu, Yiqiao Zhao, Muyang Cheng, Yuming Guo, Yan Li, Jianmin Liu, Zhonghua Wu, Yong Li, Michael E. DiSanto, Xinhua Zhang, Ping Chen
pmc-12534973.description: BackgroundBenign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) is a common disease afflicting elderly males all over the world. The existing scientific research still has not completely clarified its etiology. Pleiotrophin (PTN) is a developmental regulatory protein involved in various biological processes. This study aimed to elucidate the expression, biological function, and underlying mechanism of PTN in the onset and progression of BPH.

pmc-12612231.title: Authentication mechanism based on distributed blockchain for secure and energy efficient mobile ad-hoc networks
pmc-12612231.creator: VR Sugumaran, E Dinesh, R Ramya, Elangovan Muniyandy
pmc-12612231.description: This work addresses the security issues which occurred in the Mobile Adhoc Networks (MANETs). The earlier efforts seen in MANET are more centralized and use more power. Therefore, the objective of this study is to offer high levels of security with minimal energy usage. This work creates a unique DBlock-Auth technique for MANETs to accomplish this objective.

pmc-12808230.title: Choosing dialysis modality in patients aged 75 and above with end-stage kidney disease: a multicenter cohort study
pmc-12808230.creator: Yaohua Hu, Xueyan Zhu, Yingying Liu, Liming Yang, Zhanshan Sun, Xiaoxuan Zhang, Jian Li, Xinyang Li, Xinyu Gao, Mengyuan Yu, Wenpeng Cui
pmc-12808230.description: End-stage kidney disease (ESKD) is a growing health issue, especially among the very elderly. The optimal dialysis method for very elderly patients with ESKD remains uncertain, and there is a lack of evidence regarding the survival benefits of hemodialysis (HD) versus peritoneal dialysis (PD).

pmc-12948079.description: Cancer remains a major global health challenge with limited therapeutic options. Medicinal plants have emerged as promising candidates for anticancer drug discovery. uslaw-usc-t42-s17062.title: 42 U.S.C. § 17062 — Energy efficiency in Federal and other buildings
uslaw-usc-t42-s17062.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s17062.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 152 (Energy Independence And Security); Subchapter III (Energy Savings In Buildings And Industry). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Administrator The term “Administrator” means the Administrator of General Services. (2) Cost-effective energy efficiency measure The term “cost-effective energy efficiency measure” means any building product, material, equipment.
